Title: Java - Codeless application monitoring with Azure Monitor Application Insights in public preview

Body.Content:
Monitor Java applications in any environment without changing the code with Azure Monitor Application Insights. A preview of the new codeless Java agent is now available. It instantly enables powerful functionality and benefits such as:

  • Seamless onboarding.
  • No need to instrument the code.
  • Application monitoring in any environment.
  • A wide variety of the most-used frameworks and dependencies supported out of the box.
  • Distributed tracing—application map.

Some of the libraries and frameworks supported by the new Java agent include:

  • gRPC.
  • Netty/Webflux.
  • JMS.
  • Cassandra.
  • MongoDB.

Learn more.
